research_purpose: Bayani tradition: context-specific meanings and whole-Quran usage, word/form/order versus alternatives, literary and psychological readings, and objections to compatible-polysemy readings. Distinguish al-Khuli from secondary accounts of him.
page_focus: All 17 frozen paragraphs, including additions: divine teaching and recitation, q-r-a imagery, following/transmission, promise versus prohibition, n-s-y and forgetting/neglect, the exception and divine will, remembrance/ease/worship/earlier scriptures. Apply your family remit to these findings and secondary verses.
